+# (.claude/scripts/lib/profile-lib.sh `loa_knob`):
+#   1. the key set explicitly in .loa.config.yaml wins;

+    decisions.surface_at_session_start: false

+    karpathy_principles.require_success_criteria: true
+    guardrails.input.enabled: false
+    guardrails.danger_level.enforce: false
+    invisible_retrospective.enabled: true
+    structured_handoff.enabled: false
+    soul_identity_doc.enabled: false

# The ask reply; jq builds it so any reason is a well-formed JSON string (run-3 finding 7); the printf literal is only
# for the jq-missing branch, whose reason is a fixed string
emit_ask() {
    if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
        jq -nc --arg r "$1" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"ask",permissionDecisionReason:$r}}'
    else

# Byte sequences strip_controls removes: UTF-8 C1 controls (C2 80..C2 9F) and the format/bidi code points
# U+200B-U+200F, U+2028-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+206F, U+FEFF, U+00AD, U+061C, U+180E, U+FE00-U+FE0F,
# U+FFF9-U+FFFB and the tag characters U+E0001, U+E0020-U+E007F (run-3 finding 5); each sequence starts with a lead
# byte, so a byte-wise match never lands inside another character
# printf -v keeps this portable (no GNU-sed \x); built on first use, not on every Write/Edit (BB-008)
_IG_STRIP_SEQS=()
_ig_strip_seqs_init() {
    local _ig_i _ig_hex _ig_seq
    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 160; _ig_i++ )); do
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xc2\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for _ig_hex in 8b 8c 8d 8e 8f a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae; do
        printf -v _ig_seq "\\xe2\\x80\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for _ig_hex in a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a6 a7 a8 a9 aa ab ac ad ae af; do
        printf -v _ig_seq "\\xe2\\x81\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for _ig_seq in '\xef\xbb\xbf' '\xc2\xad' '\xd8\x9c' '\xe1\xa0\x8e' '\xef\xbf\xb9' '\xef\xbf\xba' '\xef\xbf\xbb' '\xf3\xa0\x80\x81'; do
        printf -v _ig_seq "$_ig_seq"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 144; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+FE00-U+FE0F = EF B8 80..EF B8 8F
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xef\\xb8\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for (( _ig_i = 160; _ig_i < 192; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+E0020-U+E003F = F3 A0 80 A0..F3 A0 80 BF
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xf3\\xa0\\x80\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
    for (( _ig_i = 128; _ig_i < 192; _ig_i++ )); do   # U+E0040-U+E007F = F3 A0 81 80..F3 A0 81 BF
        printf -v _ig_hex '%02x' "$_ig_i"; printf -v _ig_seq "\\xf3\\xa0\\x81\\x${_ig_hex}"; _IG_STRIP_SEQS+=("$_ig_seq")
    done
}

# Sets the variable named $1 to at most 256 bytes of $2, never ending inside a UTF-8 character: a trailing lead byte
# whose sequence the cut left short, or stray continuation bytes, are dropped (run-3 finding 5; jq would read a split
# character as U+FFFD). printf -v, not $(...), so a trailing newline in a raw value survives into the audit row
cut_utf8_256() {
    local LC_ALL=C
    local _c_s=${2:0:256} _c_n _c_i _c_b _c_need
    _c_n=${#_c_s}
    for (( _c_i = _c_n - 1; _c_i >= 0 && _c_i >= _c_n - 4; _c_i-- )); do
        printf -v _c_b '%d' "'${_c_s:_c_i:1}"
        (( _c_b >= 128 && _c_b < 192 )) && continue   # continuation byte: keep walking back to its lead
        if (( _c_b < 128 )); then _c_need=1; elif (( _c_b < 224 )); then _c_need=2; elif (( _c_b < 240 )); then _c_need=3; else _c_need=4; fi
        if (( _c_n - _c_i < _c_need )); then _c_s=${_c_s:0:_c_i}          # the cut left this character short
        elif (( _c_n - _c_i > _c_need )); then _c_s=${_c_s:0:_c_i+_c_need}   # continuation bytes after a complete character are stray
        fi
        printf -v "$1" '%s' "$_c_s"
        return 0
    done
    printf -v "$1" '%s' "${_c_s:0:_c_i+1}"   # only continuation bytes at the end: drop them
}

# Display copy of a model-authored string: cut to 256 bytes first (the fixed point below then costs at most a few
# passes over a short string), then C0 and DEL, then the sequences above byte-wise until nothing changes (deleting
# one sequence can join its neighbours into another: C2 C2 9B 9B)
strip_controls() {
    local LC_ALL=C s prev seq
    cut_utf8_256 s "$1"
    s=$(printf '%s' "$s" | tr -d '\000-\037\177')
    (( ${#_IG_STRIP_SEQS[@]} )) || _ig_strip_seqs_init
    while :; do
        prev=$s
        for seq in "${_IG_STRIP_SEQS[@]}"; do s=${s//"$seq"/}; done
        [[ "$s" == "$prev" ]] && break
    done
    printf '%s' "$s"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mode and claims (cycle-129 D-4.1): one yq call, read only when a decision
# needs it. Unset, unreadable or unknown values are ask; the legacy
# mode: authoritative is ask + claims: authoritative. run_mode.stale_hours
# bounds derived_at (positive integer, default 12).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
gate_mode="ask"
gate_claims="plain"
gate_stale_hours=12
load_gate_config() {
    local cfg="${1:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.loa.config.yaml}" raw m c s
    command -v yq &>/dev/null && command -v jq &>/dev/null && [[ -f "$cfg" ]] || return 0
    # mikefarah yq v4 first; the python yq wrapper (jq syntax, JSON out) second
    raw=$(yq -o json -I 0 '{"m": .implement_gate.mode, "c": .implement_gate.claims, "s": .run_mode.stale_hours}' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null) \
        || raw=$(yq -c '{"m": .implement_gate.mode, "c": .implement_gate.claims, "s": .run_mode.stale_hours}' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null) \
        || return 0
    m=$(jq -r '.m | strings' <<<"$raw" 2>/dev/null) || m=""
    c=$(jq -r '.c | strings' <<<"$raw" 2>/dev/null) || c=""
    s=$(jq -r '.s | numbers | tostring' <<<"$raw" 2>/dev/null) || s=""
    case "$m" in
        ask|telemetry|deny) gate_mode="$m" ;;
        authoritative) gate_claims="authoritative" ;;
    esac
    [[ "$c" == "authoritative" ]] && gate_claims="authoritative"
    if [[ "$s" =~ ^[0-9]{1,4}$ ]] && (( 10#$s > 0 && 10#$s <= 8760 )); then gate_stale_hours=$(( 10#$s )); fi
    return 0
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--effective-mode" ]]; then
    load_gate_config "${2:-}"
    if [[ "$gate_claims" == "authoritative" ]]; then echo "$gate_mode (claims: authoritative)"; else echo "$gate_mode"; fi
    exit 0
fi

    && ! jq -e '.active_skill_seen_at' "$FEATURES_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    _ig_base=$(jq -c 'select(type == "object")' "$FEATURES_FILE" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)
    _ig_tmp=$(mktemp "$RUN_DIR/.platform-features.XXXXXX" 2>/dev/null) && {
        jq -nc --argjson b "${_ig_base:-{\}}" --arg ts "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
            '$b + {active_skill_available: false, active_skill_seen_at: $ts, active_skill_source: "tool_input"}' > "$_ig_tmp" 2>/dev/null \
            && mv -f "$_ig_tmp" "$FEATURES_FILE" 2>/dev/null

    }

    emit_ask "[GATE] could not evaluate tool_input. Verify this write is intentional."
    exit 0
fi

# Extract the path: Write/Edit/MultiEdit carry file_path, NotebookEdit carries notebook_path. jq -j plus a sentinel
# byte keeps a trailing newline, which $(...) would otherwise strip from the raw value (run-3 finding 4)
if ! file_path=$(jq -j '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' <<<"$input" 2>/dev/null && printf x); then
    echo "[GATE] could not evaluate tool_input (path not readable)." >&2
    emit_ask "[GATE] could not evaluate tool_input. Verify this write is intentional."
    exit 0
fi
file_path=${file_path%x}

# A parsed payload without a path is not a file write the gate can classify: allow
if [[ -z "$file_path" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

# Lexical normaliser for an absolute path: drops empty and . components, resolves .. textually, follows no symlink

    local rest=$1 part

# True when the ISO-8601 timestamp $1 parses and is within 24 h (86400 s) of now, either side; empty or unparsable is stale

_ig_fresh() {
    [[ -n "$1" ]] || return 1

    now=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null) || return 1

_ig_within() {
    [[ -n "$2" && "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1

        '($t | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) as $e | $e != null and (now - $e) <= $w and ($e - now) <= 300' \

+# tokenizer cannot read (open quote, trailing backslash, comment), more than

+# _bdb_hd_header <line> — parse one header line. Sets _hd_ops (heredoc count,

+# _bdb_hd_segword <segment> → _hd_w (command word after wrapper stripping,

+# _bdb_hd_scan_body <first> <last> <quoted> — per-segment scan of
+# _bdb_hd_L[first..last]. Sets _hd_kept (fence-verb segments, one per line),
+# _hd_synth (variable-command segments rewritten as rm/git/kubectl) and
+# _hd_full (1 = the body needs the full scan).
+_bdb_hd_scan_body() {
+  local k l t seg
+  _hd_kept="" _hd_synth="" _hd_full=0

+# The #1245 header grammar (byte-identical to _bdb_scrub_cat_heredoc's).
+_bdb_hd_plain_cat() {
+  local header="${1:-}" marker candidate
+  local delimiter_re="<<(-?)('([[:alnum:]_]+)'|\"([[:alnum:]_]+)\")"
+  local path_re="([[:alnum:]_./-]+|'[[:alnum:]_ ./-]+'|\"[[:alnum:]_ ./-]+\")"
+  local header_re="^[[:blank:]]*cat[[:blank:]]+(HEREDOC([[:blank:]]+>>?[[:blank:]]*${path_re})?|>>?[[:blank:]]*${path_re}[[:blank:]]+HEREDOC)[[:blank:]]*$"
+  [[ "$header" =~ $delimiter_re ]] || return 1
+  marker="${BASH_REMATCH[0]}"
+  candidate="${header/"$marker"/HEREDOC}"
+  [[ "$candidate" =~ $header_re ]]

+# Knob: destructive_command_guard.heredoc_classifier in the repo's
+# .loa.config.yaml (read once, no fork, only for commands holding `<<`).
+# Only an explicit false|no|off turns it off; turning it off only tightens.
+_bdb_heredoc_knob_on() {
+  local cfg="${LOA_REPO_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}}/.loa.config.yaml" content="" l in_blk=0
+  [[ -f "$cfg" && -r "$cfg" ]] || return 0
+  IFS= read -r -d '' content < "$cfg" || true
+  [[ "$content" == *heredoc_classifier* ]] || return 0
+  while IFS= read -r l; do
+    case "$l" in
+      destructive_command_guard:*) in_blk=1; continue ;;
+      [A-Za-z_]*) in_blk=0; continue ;;
+    esac
+    if (( in_blk )) && [[ "$l" =~ $_bdb_hd_re_knob ]]; then
+      case "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" in false|False|FALSE|no|No|NO|off|Off|OFF) return 1 ;; esac

+# Exported entry points (source with BDB_LIB_ONLY=1).

+heredoc_nonexec() {
+  [[ "$(_bdb_heredoc_consumer_class "${1:-}")" == nonexec ]]

+# Library mode: only when SOURCED. Executed with BDB_LIB_ONLY=1 the hook runs

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# =============================================================================
# PreToolUse:Bash Safety Hook — Block Destructive Commands (v1.38.0)
# =============================================================================
# Blocks dangerous patterns and suggests safer alternatives.
# Exit 0 = allow, Exit 2 = block (stderr message fed back to agent).
#
# Cycle-111 (sprint-164, 2026-05-16) — ports Anthropic DCG public pattern
# set inline. Source: github.com/anthropics/destructive-command-guard
# Pattern port reference SHA: HEAD as of 2026-05-16 (no specific commit
# pin available — DCG ships rule packs, not single-file source).
# REVIEW-BY: 2026-08-16 — re-sync against upstream DCG every quarter.
#
# IMPORTANT: No set -euo pipefail — this hook must never fail closed.
# A grep or jq failure must result in exit 0 (allow), not an error.
#
# WHY fail-open (not fail-closed): A safety hook that crashes or encounters
# a parse error must NOT block the agent from operating. The alternative —
# fail-closed — would make jq/grep bugs into denial-of-service attacks
# against the agent. Fail-open with logging is the standard pattern for
# inline security hooks (cf. ModSecurity DetectionOnly mode).
# (Source: bridge-20260213-c011he iter-1 HIGH-1 fix)
#
# WHY GNU/BSD ERE (NOT strict POSIX): grep -P (PCRE) is a GNU extension not
# available on macOS/BSD or minimal containers. grep -E (Extended Regex)
# with `\s`, `\S`, `\b` extensions works on both GNU grep (Linux) and BSD
# grep (macOS Sonoma+). Strict-POSIX ERE (busybox without -E extensions)
# is NOT in scope per cycle-111 SDD §5.0 honest-scope decision.
# (Source: bridge-20260213-c011he iter-1 HIGH-1 fix; cycle-111 SDD §5.0)
#
====
# Library mode: only when SOURCED. Executed with BDB_LIB_ONLY=1 the hook runs
# normally — an environment variable can never switch the fence off.
if [[ "${BDB_LIB_ONLY:-}" == "1" && "${BASH_SOURCE[0]:-}" != "${0:-}" ]]; then
  return 0
fi

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# jq presence probe (SDD §6.5 — SKP-008 mitigation, not full fix).
# If jq is absent, the input parse on line ~120 returns empty → existing
# fail-open guard exits 0. v1.38.0 adds a one-shot stderr WARNING so the
# operator / agent sees the safety guard is disabled this session.
# Tracked as cycle-112 candidate (filesystem-marker variant for cross-
# invocation persistence; env-var doesn't propagate across hook subprocess
# invocations per Flatline SKP-002 round-3 finding).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# perf pass-11 (skill-loop, 2026-07-06): HIGH-002 fix (BB review of PR #1176).
# Passes 2 & 8 introduced bash-4-only constructs into this fence (${x,,}
# case-folding, `mapfile`); pre-loop it was bash-3.2-portable (echo|grep -i).
# macOS ships bash 3.2. This guard runs BEFORE any bash-4 expansion executes
# (bash 3.2 defers ${,,} validation and the mapfile builtin lookup to runtime,
# so a runtime guard at the first executable line runs first and never reaches
# them). If a bash >=4 exists (the framework already requires it — beads-health
# etc. source bash-version-guard.sh), re-exec under it; stdin (the hook payload)
# and argv survive exec. Otherwise FAIL CLOSED (exit 2 = block): a
# destructive-command fence must never silently allow when it cannot evaluate.
# The generic bash-version-guard.sh exits 1, which is a NON-blocking PreToolUse
# hook error (fail-OPEN) — wrong direction for this hook, hence the inline form.
if [ "${BASH_VERSINFO:-0}" -lt 4 ]; then
    for _bh_cand in /opt/homebrew/bin/bash /usr/local/bin/bash /usr/bin/bash bash; do
        if command -v "$_bh_cand" >/dev/null 2>&1; then

fi

    echo "WARNING: block-destructive-bash: jq not in PATH — destructive-command pattern matching is DISABLED for this session. Install jq to restore safety guards." >&2

+# SINCE touching a path outside the state/generated set, or nothing
+impl_commit() {
+  git -C "$root" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
+  git -C "$root" log --no-merges -n 1 --format='%H %ct' ${1:+"--since=$1"} -- . \
+    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
+    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true

+
+# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
+# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
+rounds_of() {
+  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
+  for g in review audit; do
+    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
+    top=""; topn=-1
+    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
+      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
+      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
+      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue
+      fb_parse "$f" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" --argjson n "$((10#$n))" '. + {gate: $g, round: $n}'
+      if (( 10#$n > topn )); then topn=$((10#$n)); top="$f"; fi
+    done
+    cur="$dir/$base.md"
+    if [[ -f "$cur" ]] && ! { [[ -n "$top" ]] && cmp -s "$cur" "$top"; }; then
+      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'
+    fi
+  done

+  [[ "$(cfg '.run_mode.file_authoritative')" == false ]] && fa=0
+  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
+              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
+              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
+              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
+              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
+  now=$(date +%s); now_ts=$(now_iso)
+
+  # Per-sprint facts
+  local sprints="[]" gid label lstatus since dir rv au mex msid ic sj
+  rows=$(jq -r --arg c "$active" '
+    (.cycles[] | select(.id == $c)) as $cy
+    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
+    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
+    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
+       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))
+        | if length == 0 then "" else ([.[0], ($cy.created // "")] | max) end)]
+    | map(if . == "" then "-" else . end)
+    | @tsv' "$ledger")
+  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
+    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
+    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
+    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
+    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
+    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
+    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
+    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
+    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
+    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
+    mex=false; msid=""
+    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
+      mex=true
+      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
+    fi
+    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
+    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
+              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
+      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
+      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
+      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
+      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
+      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
+      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
+      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
+      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
+      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
+      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
+       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
+       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
+       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
+       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
+                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
+       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
+       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
+               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
+    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
+  done <<<"$rows"
+
+  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
+  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
+  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
+  rounds="[]"
+  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
+    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
+  fi
+  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
+    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
+  fi
+  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
+  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
+  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
+  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")
+
+  local facts report
+  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
+    {sprints: $s,
+     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
+     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
+     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
+     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
+     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
+  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
+                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
+                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
+    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
+    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
+    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
+    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
+    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
+       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
+       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
+       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
+       notes: ([
+         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
+         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
+         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
+         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
+         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
+       ]),
+       sprints: $f.sprints,
+       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
+       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
+                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
+       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
+       written: false}')
+
+  if (( write )); then
+    local why=""
+    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
+    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
+    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
+    fi
+    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
+      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
+      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
+      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
+      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
+        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
+        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
+        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
+        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
+      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
+    else
+      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  if (( json )); then
+    jq . <<<"$report"
+  else
+    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
+           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+cmd_record_round() {
+  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
+  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
+  local p th ts now out trip
+  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
+    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
+              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
+              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
+              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
+              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
+  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
+  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
+      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
+    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
+    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
+    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
+       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
+       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
+    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
+       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
+       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
+    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
+    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
+    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
+    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
+          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
+        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
+          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
+        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
+          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
+        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
+          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
+        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
+        else null end ) as $trip
+    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
+    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
+      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
+      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
+      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
+    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
+  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
+  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.threshold), no_progress \(.triggers.no_progress.count)/\(.triggers.no_progress.threshold)"' "$breaker")
+  echo "$out"
+  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
+    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
+    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
+    return 10
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+cmd_mark() {
+  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
+  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
+  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
+    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
+  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
+    local err drc=0
+    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
+    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
+  fi
+  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
+}
+
 case "$sub" in
-  write) cmd_write ;;
-  read)  cmd_read ;;
+  write)  cmd_write ;;
+  read)   cmd_read ;;
+  derive) cmd_derive ;;
+  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;
+  mark)   cmd_mark ;;
+  unmark) rm -f -- "$run_dir/implement-active.json" "$run_dir/implement-active.json.lock"; echo "unmarked" ;;
   *) usage ;;
 esac

+# SINCE touching a path outside the state/generated set, or nothing
+impl_commit() {
+  git -C "$root" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
+  git -C "$root" log --no-merges -n 1 --format='%H %ct' ${1:+"--since=$1"} -- . \
+    ':(exclude,glob)grimoires/**' ':(exclude,glob).run/**' ':(exclude,glob)**/REPO-MAP.md' \
+    ':(exclude,glob)**/checksums.json' ':(exclude,glob)**/CHANGELOG.md' 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+# The ordered rounds of one sprint directory: every -rN file, then the current
+# file unless it is byte-identical to the highest -rN of its gate
+rounds_of() {
+  local dir="$1" g base f n top topn cur
+  for g in review audit; do
+    if [[ "$g" == review ]]; then base=engineer-feedback; else base=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
+    top=""; topn=-1
+    for f in "$dir/$base"-r*.md; do
+      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
+      n=${f##*-r}; n=${n%.md}
+      [[ "$n" =~ ^[0-9]{1,6}$ ]] || continue
+      fb_parse "$f" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" --argjson n "$((10#$n))" '. + {gate: $g, round: $n}'
+      if (( 10#$n > topn )); then topn=$((10#$n)); top="$f"; fi
+    done
+    cur="$dir/$base.md"
+    if [[ -f "$cur" ]] && ! { [[ -n "$top" ]] && cmp -s "$cur" "$top"; }; then
+      fb_parse "$cur" "$g" | jq -c --arg g "$g" '. + {gate: $g, round: 999999}'
+    fi
+  done
+}
+
+# Shared jq definitions: time, the breaker recompute and the run-state resolution
+JQ_DEFS='
+def epoch: if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch null) else null end;
+def fresh($now; $win): epoch as $t | $t != null and ($now - $t) <= $win and ($t - $now) <= 300;
+def recompute($rounds; $reset):
+  ($rounds
+   | map(select($reset == null or ((.ts // "") > $reset)))
+   | sort_by([(.ts // ""), .round, (if .gate == "review" then 0 else 1 end)])
+   | map(select(.approved | not))) as $nr
+  | reduce $nr[] as $r ({cycle: 0, same: 0, hash: null, np: 0, lc: null};
+      .cycle += 1
+      | (if $r.hash != "none" and $r.hash == .hash then .same += 1 else .same = 1 | .hash = $r.hash end)
+      | ($r.counts | tojson) as $c
+      | (if .lc != null and .lc == $c then .np += 1 else .np = 0 end)
+      | .lc = $c);
+def skeleton($th; $ts):
+  {state: "CLOSED",
+   triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: $th.same, last_hash: null},
+              no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: $th.np},
+              cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: $th.cycles},
+              timeout: {started: $ts, limit_hours: $th.hours}},
+   history: []};
+def merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts):
+  (if type == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
+  | .triggers = (.triggers // {})
+  | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ([(.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0), $rc.cycle] | max)
+  | (if $rc.same > (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0)
+     then .triggers.same_issue.count = $rc.same | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $rc.hash else . end)
+  | (if $rc.np > (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) or (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts == null and $rc.lc != null)
+     then .triggers.no_progress.count = ([(.triggers.no_progress.count // 0), $rc.np] | max)
+          | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $rc.lc else . end)
+  | ( if (.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
+        then ["same_issue", "same issue hash repeated \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times (derived from the feedback history)"]
+      elif (.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
+        then ["no_progress", "counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
+      elif (.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
+        then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds (derived from the feedback history)"]
+      else null end ) as $trip
+  | if $trip != null and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
+    then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], source: "derive"}])
+    else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end;
+def known_ids: (.derivation.sprint_ids // null) // ((.sprints.list // []) | map(.id? // empty));
+def resolve($f; $now; $win):
+  . as $c
+  | (if ($c | type) == "object" then $c else {} end) as $c
+  | ($c.state // $c.status // "") as $cs
+  | ($c | known_ids) as $known
+  | ([$f.sprints[] | select(.state != "complete")
+      | "sprint-\(.global_id)" as $g | .local_label as $l
+      | select(($known | index($g)) == null and ($l == "" or ($known | index($l)) == null))] | length > 0) as $new
+  | ((($c.completion // {}) | .merged_sha? // "") | type == "string" and length > 0) as $merged
+  | if ($c.state // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or ($c.status // "") == "JACKED_OUT" or $merged then "JACKED_OUT"
+    elif $f.breaker_open or $cs == "HALTED" then "HALTED"
+    elif $f.all_complete then "COMPLETE"
+    elif $cs == "COMPLETE" and ($new | not) then "COMPLETE"
+    elif ($c.timestamps.last_activity? // null) | fresh($now; $win) then "RUNNING"
+    else "INTERRUPTED" end;
+'
+
+cmd_derive() {

+    echo "run-checkpoint: derive: no readable ledger at $ledger — callers keep the cache" >&2; return 4

+  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
+              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
+              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
+              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \

+  # Per-sprint facts

+    | ($cy.sprints // [])[]
+    | select((.global_id | type) == "number")
+    | [(.global_id | tostring), ((.local_label // "") | tostring), ((.status // "") | tostring),
+       ([.started, .created, $cy.created] | map(select(type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-")))

+  # "-" stands for an empty field: IFS whitespace (tab) would collapse two adjacent separators
+  while IFS=$'\t' read -r gid label lstatus since; do
+    [[ "$gid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
+    [[ "$label" == - ]] && label=""
+    [[ "$since" == - ]] && since=""
+    [[ "$label" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$ ]] || label=""
+    [[ "$lstatus" =~ ^[a-z_]{1,32}$ ]] || lstatus="unknown"
+    [[ "$since" =~ ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z$ ]] || since=""
+    dir="$a2a/sprint-$gid"
+    rv=$(fb_parse "$dir/engineer-feedback.md" review)
+    au=$(fb_parse "$dir/auditor-sprint-feedback.md" audit)
+    mex=false; msid=""
+    if [[ -f "$dir/COMPLETED" ]]; then
+      mex=true
+      msid=$(sed -n 's/^sprint:[[:space:]]*\([A-Za-z0-9._-]*\).*/\1/p' "$dir/COMPLETED" | head -n 1) || msid=""
+    fi
+    ic=$(impl_commit "$since")
+    sj=$(jq -nc --argjson gid "$gid" --arg label "$label" --arg status "$lstatus" --argjson rv "$rv" --argjson au "$au" \
+              --argjson mex "$mex" --arg msid "$msid" --arg ic "$ic" '
+      def mine: type == "string" and length > 0 and (. == "sprint-\($gid)" or ($label != "" and . == $label));
+      ($rv.approved == true and ($rv.sprint_id | mine)) as $R
+      | ($au.approved == true and ($au.sprint_id | mine)) as $A
+      | ([$rv.sprint_id, $au.sprint_id, (if $msid == "" then null else $msid end)] | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0))) as $ids
+      | ($mex and any($ids[]; mine | not)) as $stale
+      | ($mex and ($stale | not) and (($rv.sprint_id | mine) or ($au.sprint_id | mine))) as $M
+      | ($ic | split(" ")) as $c
+      | ([$rv.ts, $au.ts] | map(select(. != null)) | max) as $vts
+      | def verdict($x): if $x.exists then {verdict: $x.verdict, sprint_id: $x.sprint_id, consistent: ($x.exit_code == 0), file: $x.file} else null end;
+      {global_id: $gid, local_label: $label, status: $status,
+       completed_marker: $M, marker_present: $mex, stale_marker: $stale,
+       review: verdict($rv), audit: verdict($au),
+       impl_commit: (if ($c | length) == 2 then $c[0] else null end),
+       commit_after_verdict: (if ($c | length) == 2 and $vts != null
+                              then (($c[1] | tonumber) > ($vts | sub("\\.[0-9]+Z$"; "Z") | try fromdateiso8601 catch 0)) else null end),
+       legacy_feedback: ([$rv, $au] | map(select(.exists and (.trailer | not)) | .file)),
+       state: (if $M and $R and $A and $status == "completed" then "complete"
+               elif ($M | not) and $R and $A then "awaiting_marker" else "in_progress" end)}')
+    sprints=$(jq -c --argjson s "$sj" '. + [$s]' <<<"$sprints")
+  done <<<"$rows"
+
+  # Breaker recompute over the active sprint's ordered rounds
+  local active_gid rounds cache="null" cache_ok=1 bcache="null" reset rc merged
+  active_gid=$(jq -r 'if length == 0 then "" else ((map(select(.state != "complete")) | .[0]) // .[-1]) | .global_id | tostring end' <<<"$sprints")
+  rounds="[]"
+  if [[ -n "$active_gid" && -d "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" ]]; then
+    rounds=$(rounds_of "$a2a/sprint-$active_gid" | jq -sc '.')
+  fi
+  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
+    if cache=$(jq -c . "$file" 2>/dev/null) && [[ -n "$cache" ]]; then :; else cache="null"; cache_ok=0; fi
+  fi
+  if [[ -f "$breaker" ]]; then bcache=$(jq -c 'if type == "object" then . else null end' "$breaker" 2>/dev/null) || bcache="null"; [[ -n "$bcache" ]] || bcache="null"; fi
+  reset=$(jq -c '.reset_at? // null | if type == "string" then . else null end' <<<"$bcache")
+  rc=$(jq -nc --argjson r "$rounds" --argjson z "$reset" "$JQ_DEFS"' recompute($r; $z)')
+  merged=$(jq -c --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' <<<"$bcache")
+
+  local facts report
+  facts=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$sprints" --argjson b "$merged" '
+    {sprints: $s,
+     all_complete: (($s | length) > 0 and all($s[]; .state == "complete")),
+     breaker_open: ($b.state == "OPEN"),
+     stale_markers: [$s[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id)"],
+     legacy_feedback: [$s[] | .legacy_feedback[]],
+     sprint_ids: [$s[] | "sprint-\(.global_id)"]}')
+  report=$(jq -nc --argjson f "$facts" --argjson c "$cache" --argjson b "$merged" --argjson rc "$rc" \
+                  --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" --arg cycle "$active" \
+                  --argjson fa "$fa" --argjson cache_ok "$cache_ok" --arg ag "$active_gid" "$JQ_DEFS"'
+    def st: if type == "string" then (if test("^[A-Z_]{1,32}$") then . else "INVALID" end) else null end;
+    ($c | resolve($f; $now; $win)) as $s
+    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.state | st) else null end) as $cs
+    | ($c | if type == "object" then (.status | st) else null end) as $cst
+    | {cycle: $cycle, derived_at: $ts, stale_hours: ($win / 3600), file_authoritative: ($fa == 1),
+       state: $s, cache_state: $cs, cache_status: $cst,
+       cache: (if $cache_ok == 0 then "unparseable" elif $c == null then "missing" else "present" end),
+       drift: ($c != null and ($cs != $s or ($cst != null and $cst != $s))),
+       notes: ([
+         (if $cs != null and $cst != null and $cs != $cst then "cache .state \($cs) and .status \($cst) disagree" else empty end),
+         (if $s == "JACKED_OUT" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "JACKED_OUT is terminal: files show incomplete sprints; the cache is kept" else empty end),
+         (if $s == "COMPLETE" and ($f.all_complete | not) then "COMPLETE kept: no new incomplete sprint in the ledger" else empty end),
+         ($f.sprints[] | select(.stale_marker) | "sprint-\(.global_id): COMPLETED marker names another sprint (stale_marker, not counted)"),
+         ($f.sprints[] | select(.state == "awaiting_marker") | "sprint-\(.global_id): review and audit APPROVED, no COMPLETED marker")
+       ]),
+       sprints: $f.sprints,
+       active_sprint: (if $ag == "" then null else "sprint-\($ag)" end),
+       breaker: {state: $b.state, cycle_count: $b.triggers.cycle_count.current, same_issue: $b.triggers.same_issue.count,
+                 no_progress: $b.triggers.no_progress.count, recomputed: {cycle_count: $rc.cycle, same_issue: $rc.same, no_progress: $rc.np}},
+       derivation: {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback},
+       written: false}')
+
+  if (( write )); then
+    local why=""
+    if (( fa == 0 )); then why="run_mode.file_authoritative: false — report-only"
+    elif [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then why="no run state at $file — nothing to rewrite"
+    elif (( cache_ok == 0 )); then why="$file unparseable — kept for inspection, not rewritten"
+    fi
+    if [[ -z "$why" ]]; then
+      atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson rc "$rc" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"' merge_breaker($rc; $th; $ts)' || return 3
+      merged=$(jq -c . "$breaker")
+      facts=$(jq -c --argjson b "$merged" '.breaker_open = ($b.state == "OPEN")' <<<"$facts")
+      atomic_update "$file" --argjson f "$facts" --argjson now "$now" --argjson win "$win" --arg ts "$now_ts" "$JQ_DEFS"'
+        resolve($f; $now; $win) as $s
+        | .state = $s | .status = $s | .derived_at = $ts
+        | .derivation = {source: "files", stale_markers: $f.stale_markers, legacy_feedback: $f.legacy_feedback, sprint_ids: $f.sprint_ids}
+        | .schema_version = (.schema_version // 2)' || return 3
+      report=$(jq -c --slurpfile c "$file" --argjson b "$merged" '.written = true | .state = $c[0].state | .breaker.state = $b.state' <<<"$report")
+    else
+      report=$(jq -c --arg w "$why" '.notes += [$w]' <<<"$report")
+    fi
+  fi
+
+  if (( json )); then
+    jq . <<<"$report"
+  else
+    jq -r '"derive: files say \(.state), cache said \(.cache_state // "nothing") (\(if .drift then "drift" else "in sync" end))"
+           + (if .written then " — caches rewritten" else "" end), (.notes[] | "  note: " + .)' <<<"$report"
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+cmd_record_round() {
+  [[ -n "$gate" && -n "$file" ]] || usage
+  if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then echo "run-checkpoint: record-round: no feedback file at $file" >&2; return 2; fi
+  local p th ts now out trip
+  p=$(fb_parse "$file" "$gate")
+  if [[ "$(jq -r '.approved' <<<"$p")" == true ]]; then
+    echo "recorded: $gate APPROVED — breaker counters unchanged"
+    return 0
+  fi
+  th=$(jq -nc --argjson s "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.same_issue_threshold' 3 1000)" \
+              --argjson n "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.circuit_breaker.no_progress_threshold' 5 1000)" \
+              --argjson c "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.max_cycles' 20 10000)" \
+              --argjson h "$(cfg_int '.run_mode.defaults.timeout_hours' 8 8760)" \
+              '{same: $s, np: $n, cycles: $c, hours: $h}')
+  ts=$(now_iso); now=$(date +%s)
+  atomic_update "$breaker" --argjson p "$p" --argjson th "$th" --arg ts "$ts" --argjson now "$now" \
+      --arg gate "$gate" --arg sprint "$sprint" "$JQ_DEFS"'
+    (if type == "object" and (.triggers | type) == "object" then . else skeleton($th; $ts) end)
+    | ($p.counts | tojson) as $c
+    | (if $p.hash != "none" and $p.hash == (.triggers.same_issue.last_hash // null)
+       then .triggers.same_issue.count = ((.triggers.same_issue.count // 0) + 1)
+       else .triggers.same_issue.count = 1 | .triggers.same_issue.last_hash = $p.hash end)
+    | (if (.triggers.no_progress.last_counts // null) != null and .triggers.no_progress.last_counts == $c
+       then .triggers.no_progress.count = ((.triggers.no_progress.count // 0) + 1)
+       else .triggers.no_progress.count = 0 end)
+    | .triggers.no_progress.last_counts = $c
+    | .triggers.cycle_count.current = ((.triggers.cycle_count.current // 0) + 1)
+    | (.triggers.timeout.started // null | epoch) as $start
+    | ( if .triggers.same_issue.count >= (.triggers.same_issue.threshold // $th.same)
+          then ["same_issue", "same issue hash \($p.hash[0:8]) seen \(.triggers.same_issue.count) times in a row"]
+        elif .triggers.no_progress.count >= (.triggers.no_progress.threshold // $th.np)
+          then ["no_progress", "finding counts unchanged for \(.triggers.no_progress.count) consecutive rounds"]
+        elif .triggers.cycle_count.current >= (.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)
+          then ["cycle_count", "\(.triggers.cycle_count.current) changes-required rounds reached the limit \(.triggers.cycle_count.limit // $th.cycles)"]
+        elif $start != null and ($now - $start) >= ((.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) * 3600)
+          then ["timeout", "run older than \(.triggers.timeout.limit_hours // $th.hours) hours"]
+        elif (.state // "CLOSED") == "OPEN" then ["open", "breaker already OPEN"]
+        else null end ) as $trip
+    | .last_round = {gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end), verdict: $p.verdict, hash: $p.hash, ts: $ts}
+    | if $trip != null and $trip[0] != "open" and (.state // "CLOSED") != "OPEN"
+      then .state = "OPEN" | .history = ((.history // []) + [{timestamp: $ts, trigger: $trip[0], reason: $trip[1], gate: $gate, sprint: (if $sprint == "" then null else $sprint end)}])
+      elif $trip != null then .state = "OPEN"
+      else .state = (.state // "CLOSED") end
+    | .last_trip = $trip' || return 3
+  trip=$(jq -r '.last_trip // empty | if type == "array" then "\(.[0]): \(.[1])" else empty end' "$breaker")
+  out=$(jq -r '"recorded: \(.last_round.gate) \(.last_round.verdict // "no verdict") — cycle \(.triggers.cycle_count.current)/\(.triggers.cycle_count.limit), same_issue \(.triggers.same_issue.count)/\(.triggers.same_issue.threshold), no_progress \(.triggers.no_progress.count)/\(.triggers.no_progress.threshold)"' "$breaker")
+  echo "$out"
+  if [[ -n "$trip" ]]; then
+    atomic_update "$state_file" --arg ts "$ts" '.state = "HALTED"' || return 3
+    echo "TRIPPED: $trip"
+    return 10
+  fi
+  return 0
+}
+
+cmd_mark() {
+  [[ -n "$skill" && -n "$sprint" ]] || usage
+  mkdir -p "$run_dir"
+  atomic_update "$run_dir/implement-active.json" --arg k "$skill" --arg s "$sprint" --arg ts "$(now_iso)" \
+    '{skill: $k, sprint: $s, started_at: $ts}' || return 3
+  if [[ -f "$file" ]]; then
+    local err drc=0
+    err=$( { write=1; json=0; cmd_derive >/dev/null; } 2>&1 ) || drc=$?
+    if (( drc != 0 && drc != 4 )); then printf '%s\n' "$err" >&2; fi
+  fi
+  echo "marked: $skill $sprint ($run_dir/implement-active.json)"
+}
+
 case "$sub" in
-  write) cmd_write ;;
-  read)  cmd_read ;;
+  write)  cmd_write ;;
+  read)   cmd_read ;;
+  derive) cmd_derive ;;
+  record-round) cmd_record_round ;;
+  mark)   cmd_mark ;;
+  unmark) rm -f -- "$run_dir/implement-active.json" "$run_dir/implement-active.json.lock"; echo "unmarked" ;;
   *) usage ;;
 esac

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/run-checkpoint-derive.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 2 Task 2.10
+# (PRD FR-5 AC-5.1 … AC-5.4, FR-4(f) AC-4.6; SDD D-5.1, D-5.1a, D-5.2, D-5.3, D-5.4)
+# `run-checkpoint.sh derive` rebuilds the run position from files: one case per
+# decision-table row, the breaker recompute from the feedback history, the
+# write path and its rollback knob, and one case per known reader over a
+# derived file. Fixture: a tiny git repo with a ledger, a2a/ and .run/ in a
+# temp dir; nothing touches this checkout's .run/.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+  CK="$REPO/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rcd.XXXXXX")"
+  R="$T/repo"
+  mkdir -p "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a" "$R/.run" "$R/src"
+  git -C "$R" init -q
+  printf 'x\n' > "$R/src/a.ts"
+  git -C "$R" add -A
+  git -C "$R" -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@example.invalid commit -qm "feat: impl"
+  ledger completed completed completed
+  unset LOA_RUN_DIR LOA_IMPLEMENT_GATE_OVERRIDE
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+# ledger STATUS101 STATUS102 STATUS103 [EXTRA-SPRINT-JSON]
+ledger() {
+  jq -n --arg a "$1" --arg b "$2" --arg c "$3" --argjson x "${4:-null}" '
+    {schema_version: 1, active_cycle: "cycle-x", next_sprint_number: 104,
+     cycles: [
+       {id: "cycle-old", status: "archived", created: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
+        sprints: [{global_id: 1, local_label: "sprint-1", status: "completed", created: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]},
+       {id: "cycle-x", status: "active", created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
+        sprints: ([{global_id: 101, local_label: "sprint-1", status: $a, created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
+                   {global_id: 102, local_label: "sprint-2", status: $b, created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"},
+                   {global_id: 103, local_label: "sprint-3", status: $c, created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}]
+                  + (if $x == null then [] else [$x] end))}]}' > "$R/grimoires/loa/ledger.json"
+}
+
+# feedback GID GATE VERDICT [SPRINT_ID] [ROUND] [MEDIUM] [TS] — a feedback file whose trailer verdict-derive accepts
+feedback() {
+  local gid="$1" gate="$2" verdict="$3" sid="${4:-sprint-$1}" round="${5:-}" med="${6:-0}" ts="${7:-2026-06-01T00:00:00Z}" f prose
+  mkdir -p "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-$gid"
+  if [[ "$gate" == review ]]; then f=engineer-feedback; else f=auditor-sprint-feedback; fi
+  [[ -n "$round" ]] && f="$f-r$round"
+  if [[ "$verdict" == APPROVED ]]; then
+    if [[ "$gate" == review ]]; then prose='All good'; else prose="APPROVED - LET'S FUCKING GO"; fi
+  else
+    prose=$'# Feedback\n\n## Findings\n\n- MEDIUM: something to fix'
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n\n<!-- LOA-VERDICT {"gate":"%s","verdict":"%s","counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":%s,"low":0},"sprint_id":"%s","ts":"%s"} -->\n' \
+    "$prose" "$gate" "$verdict" "$med" "$sid" "$ts" > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-$gid/$f.md"
+}
+
+# complete GID [SPRINT_ID] — review + audit APPROVED and the COMPLETED marker
+complete() {
+  feedback "$1" review APPROVED "${2:-}"
+  feedback "$1" audit APPROVED "${2:-}"
+  printf 'COMPLETED 2026-06-01T00:00:00Z\nsprint: %s\n' "${2:-sprint-$1}" > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-$1/COMPLETED"
+}
+
+# cache STATE [AGE_HOURS] [EXTRA-JQ] — .run/sprint-plan-state.json (jq now: portable, no GNU date -d)
+cache() {
+  jq -n --arg s "$1" --argjson h "${2:-0}" '
+    {schema_version: 2, plan_id: "plan-x", branch: "feature/x", state: $s,
+     timestamps: {started: "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z", last_activity: (now - $h * 3600 | floor | todate)},
+     sprints: {total: 3, completed: 0, current: "sprint-1",
+               list: [{id: "sprint-1", status: "in_progress"}, {id: "sprint-2", status: "pending"}, {id: "sprint-3", status: "pending"}]}}
+    '"${3:+| $3}" > "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+}
+
+derive() { run --separate-stderr bash "$CK" derive --root "$R" "$@"; }
+_md5() { if command -v md5sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else md5 -q; fi; }
+dj() { jq -r "$1" <<<"$output"; }
+
+# --- decision table: run state -------------------------------------------------
+
+@test "RCD-1 drift fixture (D-5.4): cache RUNNING, three COMPLETED markers with APPROVED trailers, ledger completed → COMPLETE; --write makes the cache say so" {
+  complete 101; complete 102; complete 103
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = COMPLETE ]
+  [ "$(dj '.cache_state')" = RUNNING ]
+  [ "$(dj '.drift')" = true ]
+  [ "$(dj '[.sprints[].state] | join(",")')" = "complete,complete,complete" ]
+  [ "$(dj '[.sprints[].completed_marker] | all')" = true ]
+  [ "$(dj '.written')" = false ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .state "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json")" = RUNNING ]   # --json alone writes nothing
+  derive --json --write
+  [ "$(dj '.written')" = true ]
+  run jq -r '[.state, .status, (.derived_at | test("^20[0-9]{2}-")), .derivation.source, .schema_version, .plan_id, .sprints.total] | map(tostring) | join(" ")' "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+  [ "$output" = "COMPLETE COMPLETE true files 2 plan-x 3" ]
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.drift')" = false ]
+  [ -z "$(find "$R/.run" -name '*.tmp.*')" ]
+}
+
+@test "RCD-2 a stale marker whose trailers name sprint-1 of another cycle (or whose sprint: line names another sprint) is stale_marker, not counted" {
+  complete 101; complete 102; complete 103 sprint-1
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2] | [.marker_present, .stale_marker, .completed_marker, .state] | map(tostring) | join(" ")')" = "true true false in_progress" ]
+  [ "$(dj '.derivation.stale_markers | join(",")')" = "sprint-103" ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = RUNNING ]
+  [[ "$(dj '.notes | join(";")')" == *"sprint-103: COMPLETED marker names another sprint"* ]]
+  # trailers right, marker line wrong → still stale
+  complete 103
+  printf 'COMPLETED x\nsprint: sprint-7\n' > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/COMPLETED"
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].stale_marker')" = true ]
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = awaiting_marker ]
+  # the local label is this sprint's name too
+  complete 103 sprint-3
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = complete ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = COMPLETE ]
+}
+
+@test "RCD-3 legacy feedback (no LOA-VERDICT trailer) yields no verdict: the sprint stays incomplete and the file is named in derivation.legacy_feedback" {
+  complete 101; complete 102; complete 103
+  printf 'All good\n' > "$R/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/engineer-feedback.md"
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].review.verdict')" = null ]
+  [ "$(dj '.sprints[2].state')" = in_progress ]
+  [ "$(dj '.derivation.legacy_feedback | join(",")')" = "grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/engineer-feedback.md" ]
+  [ "$(dj '.state')" = RUNNING ]
+  derive --write
+  [ "$(jq -r '.derivation.legacy_feedback[0]' "$R/.run/sprint-plan-state.json")" = "grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-103/engineer-feedback.md" ]
+}
+
+@test "RCD-4 review and audit APPROVED without a marker is awaiting_marker (counted incomplete); a marker with the ledger row not completed is in_progress" {
+  complete 101; complete 102
+  feedback 103 review APPROVED; feedback 103 audit APPROVED
+  cache RUNNING
+  derive --json

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/run-checkpoint-record-round.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 2 Task 2.5
+# (PRD FR-4(f) AC-4.6; SDD D-4.6). `run-checkpoint.sh record-round` replaces the
+# run-mode SKILL's breaker prose: the same-issue hash from the derived verdict,
+# no-progress, cycle count, timeout; a trip writes OPEN + HALTED and exits 10.
+# All files live in a temp dir.
+# =============================================================================
+
+setup() {
+  REPO="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+  CK="$REPO/.claude/scripts/run-checkpoint.sh"
+  VD="$REPO/.claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh"
+  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rcr.XXXXXX")"
+  mkdir -p "$T/.run" "$T/a2a"
+  B="$T/.run/circuit-breaker.json"
+  S="$T/.run/state.json"
+  printf '{"run_id":"r","state":"RUNNING","phase":"REVIEW"}\n' > "$S"
+}
+teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
+
+# fb NAME GATE VERDICT [MEDIUM] — a feedback file verdict-derive accepts
+fb() {
+  local prose
+  if [[ "$3" == APPROVED ]]; then
+    if [[ "$2" == review ]]; then prose='All good'; else prose="APPROVED - LET'S FUCKING GO"; fi
+  else
+    prose=$'# Feedback\n\n## Findings\n\n- MEDIUM: fix it'
+  fi
+  printf '%s\n\n<!-- LOA-VERDICT {"gate":"%s","verdict":"%s","counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":%s,"low":0},"sprint_id":"sprint-1","ts":"2026-06-01T00:00:00Z"} -->\n' \
+    "$prose" "$2" "$3" "${4:-0}" > "$T/a2a/$1"
+}
+
+_md5() { if command -v md5sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else md5 -q; fi; }
+
+breaker() {  # $1 jq tweak over a CLOSED breaker started now
+  jq -n '{state: "CLOSED",
+          triggers: {same_issue: {count: 0, threshold: 3, last_hash: null}, no_progress: {count: 0, threshold: 5},
+                     cycle_count: {current: 0, limit: 20}, timeout: {started: (now | floor | todate), limit_hours: 8}},
+          history: []}'"${1:+ | $1}" > "$B"
+}
+
+rr() { run --separate-stderr bash "$CK" record-round --root "$T" --breaker "$B" --state-file "$S" --sprint sprint-1 "$@"; }
+
+@test "RCR-1 a CHANGES_REQUIRED review increments cycle_count.current, sets same_issue {count 1, last_hash} to the SKILL's derived hash, exit 0" {
+  breaker
+  fb engineer-feedback.md review CHANGES_REQUIRED 1
+  rr --gate review --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [[ "$output" == "recorded: review CHANGES_REQUIRED — cycle 1/20, same_issue 1/3, no_progress 0/5" ]]
+  local want
+  want=$(bash "$VD" --file "$T/a2a/engineer-feedback.md" --gate review --json 2>/dev/null | jq -Sc '{verdict,counts}' | _md5)
+  run jq -r '[.state, .triggers.cycle_count.current, .triggers.same_issue.count, .triggers.same_issue.last_hash, (.history | length)] | map(tostring) | join(" ")' "$B"
+  [ "$output" = "CLOSED 1 1 $want 0" ]
+  [ "$(jq -r .state "$S")" = RUNNING ]
+}
+
+@test "RCR-2 the same hash again counts up; a different finding set resets same_issue to 1 with the new last_hash" {
+  breaker

-#     strings. Cold-path sum consistency: cache write additionally
-#     requires post-size == pre-size + len(entry)+1 (nothing else appended
-#     between the pre-stat and our append).

-#     fields already extracted (stdin is consumed) and recompute

+optional_table_heading() {
+  local section="$1" entry o_name o_heading

+# Removes an optional table block from FILE: the exact heading line, the
+# table-header lines between it and the start marker, the marker block, and
+# one blank line after the end marker. A file without the start marker is
+# already pruned (no-op). Anything else between the heading and the start
+# marker, a missing heading or a missing end marker is an error and leaves
+# FILE untouched.
+prune_optional_table() {
+  local file="$1" section="$2" heading="$3"

+    verbose "Optional section ${section} already absent from ${file}"

+    state == "after" { state = "done"; if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) next }
+    { print }
+    END {
+      if (state == "head") flush()
+      if (state == "skip") exit 3
+      if (state == "" ) exit 4
+    }

+      4) log "ERROR: ${file}: optional section '${section}' has markers but no '${heading}' heading directly above its table" ;;
+      *) log "ERROR: ${file}: pruning optional section '${section}' failed (awk exit ${rc})" ;;

+    if (( sanctioned )); then
+        case "$sanction" in run_fresh) echo "allow allow/sanctioned_run" ;; marker_fresh) echo "allow allow/sanctioned_marker" ;; *) echo "allow allow/override" ;; esac
+        return
+    fi
+    case "$mode" in
+        ask) echo "ask ask/ask" ;;
+        telemetry) echo "allow telemetry/outside_run" ;;
+        deny) if (( known )); then echo "deny deny/deny"; else echo "ask ask/unknown_position"; fi ;;

+# Runs every claims × write × sanction × cache cell for one mode and checks decision, row, row count, replay flag
+run_mode_matrix() {
+    local mode="$1" claims wclass sanction cache path got want row rows n_note n
+    command -v yq >/dev/null || skip "yq not installed"
+    for claims in plain authoritative; do
+        cfg_gate "$mode" "$claims"
+        for wclass in app trust; do
+            if [[ "$wclass" == app ]]; then path="$ROOT/src/x.ts"; else path="$ROOT/.run/state.json"; fi
+            for sanction in none run_fresh run_stale marker_fresh marker_stale override; do
+                for cache in fresh stale missing unparseable; do
+                    case "$sanction" in run_*) [[ "$cache" == fresh ]] || continue; cache="$sanction" ;; esac
+                    cache_state "$cache"; marker_state "$sanction"
+                    rm -f "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl"
+                    gate_cell "$path" "$claims" "$([[ "$sanction" == override ]] && echo 1)"
+                    local cell="mode=$mode claims=$claims write=$wclass sanction=$sanction cache=$cache"
+                    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$cell: exit $status" >&2; return 1; }
+                    want=$(expect_cell "$mode" "$claims" "$wclass" "$sanction" "$cache")
+                    got="$(decision3)"
+                    [ "$got" = "${want%% *}" ] || { echo "$cell: expected ${want%% *}, got $got" >&2; return 1; }
+                    # the write's decision row: the claim row (model_signal), the trust row (state_write) or the gate row
+                    row=$(jq -sr 'map(select(.action != "note" and (.hook == "implement-gate"))) | if length == 1 then "\(.[0].action)/\(.[0].decision)" else "count:\(length)" end' "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl" 2>/dev/null) || row="no-rows"
+                    [ "$row" = "${want#* }" ] || { echo "$cell: expected row ${want#* }, got $row" >&2; cat "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl" >&2; return 1; }
+                    # a stale marker logs stale_marker (and never sanctions) whenever the run path did not sanction first
+                    n_note=$(jq -s 'map(select(.decision == "stale_marker")) | length' "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl")
+                    if [[ "$wclass" == app && "$sanction" == marker_stale ]]; then
+                        [ "$n_note" = 1 ] || { echo "$cell: expected one stale_marker row, got $n_note" >&2; return 1; }
+                    else
+                        [ "$n_note" = 0 ] || { echo "$cell: unexpected stale_marker row" >&2; return 1; }
+                    fi
+                    # every row this gate wrote carries replay: true under LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 (DEC-0167)
+                    n=$(jq -s 'map(select(.replay != true)) | length' "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl")
+                    [ "$n" = 0 ] || { echo "$cell: $n rows without replay: true" >&2; return 1; }
+                    # telemetry prints nothing at all
+                    if [[ "${want#* }" == telemetry/outside_run ]]; then
+                        [[ -z "$output" && -z "$stderr" ]] || { echo "$cell: telemetry printed something" >&2; return 1; }
+                    fi
+                done
+            done
+        done
+    done

+                    case "$sanction" in run_*) [[ "$cache" == fresh ]] || continue; cache="$sanction" ;; esac
+                    cache_state "$cache"; marker_state "$sanction"
+                    rm -f "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl"
+                    gate_cell "$path" "$claims" "$([[ "$sanction" == override ]] && echo 1)"
+                    local cell="mode=$mode claims=$claims write=$wclass sanction=$sanction cache=$cache"
+                    [ "$status" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$cell: exit $status" >&2; return 1; }
+                    want=$(expect_cell "$mode" "$claims" "$wclass" "$sanction" "$cache")
+                    got="$(decision3)"
+                    [ "$got" = "${want%% *}" ] || { echo "$cell: expected ${want%% *}, got $got" >&2; return 1; }
+                    # the write's decision row: the claim row (model_signal), the trust row (state_write) or the gate row
+                    row=$(jq -sr 'map(select(.action != "note" and (.hook == "implement-gate"))) | if length == 1 then "\(.[0].action)/\(.[0].decision)" else "count:\(length)" end' "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl" 2>/dev/null) || row="no-rows"
+                    [ "$row" = "${want#* }" ] || { echo "$cell: expected row ${want#* }, got $row" >&2; cat "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl" >&2; return 1; }
+                    # a stale marker logs stale_marker (and never sanctions) whenever the run path did not sanction first
+                    n_note=$(jq -s 'map(select(.decision == "stale_marker")) | length' "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl")
+                    if [[ "$wclass" == app && "$sanction" == marker_stale ]]; then
+                        [ "$n_note" = 1 ] || { echo "$cell: expected one stale_marker row, got $n_note" >&2; return 1; }
+                    else
+                        [ "$n_note" = 0 ] || { echo "$cell: unexpected stale_marker row" >&2; return 1; }
+                    fi
+                    # every row this gate wrote carries replay: true under LOA_AUDIT_REPLAY=1 (DEC-0167)
+                    n=$(jq -s 'map(select(.replay != true)) | length' "$ROOT/.run/audit.jsonl")
+                    [ "$n" = 0 ] || { echo "$cell: $n rows without replay: true" >&2; return 1; }
+                    # telemetry prints nothing at all
+                    if [[ "${want#* }" == telemetry/outside_run ]]; then
+                        [[ -z "$output" && -z "$stderr" ]] || { echo "$cell: telemetry printed something" >&2; return 1; }
+                    fi
+                done
+            done
+        done
+    done

+#!/usr/bin/env bats
+# =============================================================================
+# tests/unit/karpathy-surgical-diff.bats — cycle-129 sprint-256 Task 2.3
+# (AC-2.3; PRD AC-4.3; SDD D-4.3, D-4.2a; DEC-0141)
+#
+# The surgical-diff hook keys its running total on the checkpoint task
+# (`run-checkpoint.sh read --json`), else the sprint, else the session id;
+# keeps one sanitised file per task under the state directory (at most 20);
+# deletes the legacy session-long file; writes the summary the review's
+# SURGICAL axis reads; and is silent when the knob is off. A fixture
+# checkpoint (LOA_RUN_DIR) and a fake `br` on PATH stand in for a live run.
+# =============================================================================
+
+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
+
+setup() {
+    R="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
+    HOOK="$R/.claude/hooks/quality/karpathy-surgical-diff-check.sh"
+    command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "jq not available"
+    command -v yq >/dev/null 2>&1 || skip "yq not available"
+    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
+    export LOA_CONFIG_OVERRIDE="$T/config.yaml"
+    export KARPATHY_STATE_DIR="$T/state"
+    export KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE="$T/summary.json"
+    export KARPATHY_LEGACY_STATE="$T/karpathy-task-state.jsonl"
+    export KARPATHY_TRAJECTORY_DIR="$T/trajectory"
+    export LOA_RUN_DIR="$T/run"
+    unset LOA_SESSION_ID LOA_PROFILE_CONFIG_FILE LOA_PROFILE_CACHE_FILE
+    mkdir -p "$T/run" "$T/bin"
+    printf 'karpathy_principles:\n  surgical_diff_warning: true\n  diff_lines_per_task: 5\n' > "$LOA_CONFIG_OVERRIDE"
+    # Fake beads: every bead reports closed unless BR_STATUS says otherwise.
+    printf '%s\n' '#!/usr/bin/env bash' 'printf "{\"status\":\"%s\"}\n" "${BR_STATUS:-closed}"' > "$T/bin/br"
+    chmod +x "$T/bin/br"
+    export PATH="$T/bin:$PATH"
+}
+
+# checkpoint <sprint> [task] — a schema-2 run state with that checkpoint
+checkpoint() {
+    jq -n --arg s "$1" --arg t "${2:-}" \
+        '{schema_version: 2, state: "RUNNING",
+          checkpoint: {sprint: $s, task: (if $t == "" then null else $t end), phase: "IMPLEMENT", ts: "2026-10-14T00:00:00Z"}}' \
+        > "$T/run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+}
+
+# write_lines <n> [session_id] — one Write payload adding n lines
+write_lines() {
+    local n="$1" sid="${2:-sess-1}" content
+    content=$(seq 1 "$n" | paste -sd'\n' -)
+    jq -nc --arg c "$content" --arg s "$sid" \
+        '{tool_name: "Write", session_id: $s, tool_input: {file_path: "/repo/src/x.sh", content: $c}}' \
+        | bash "$HOOK"
+}
+
+@test "KS-1 the counter resets when the checkpoint task changes" {
+    checkpoint sprint-256 bd-aaa
+    write_lines 3
+    write_lines 2
+    [ "$(jq -r '.task' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "bd-aaa" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.lines' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "5" ]
+    checkpoint sprint-256 bd-bbb
+    write_lines 2
+    [ "$(jq -r '.task' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "bd-bbb" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.lines' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "2" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.over' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "false" ]
+    [ "$(wc -l < "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-aaa.jsonl")" -eq 2 ]
+    [ "$(wc -l < "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-bbb.jsonl")" -eq 1 ]
+    [ "$(tail -1 "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-aaa.jsonl" | jq -r '.running_total')" = "5" ]
+}
+

+    [ "$(jq -r '.task' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "abc-123" ]

+        | LOA_SESSION_ID=env-sess bash "$HOOK"
+    [ -f "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/env-sess.jsonl" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.lines' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "2" ]
+}
+
+@test "KS-3 a checkpoint whose task is still open in beads keys on the sprint" {
+    checkpoint sprint-256 bd-open
+    BR_STATUS=open write_lines 2
+    [ -f "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/sprint-256.jsonl" ]
+    [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-open.jsonl" ]
+    # A sprint-granularity checkpoint (no task) keys on the sprint too.
+    checkpoint sprint-257
+    write_lines 1
+    [ "$(jq -r '.task' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "sprint-257" ]
+}

+@test "KS-4 the summary carries exactly task, lines, threshold, over, updated_at after each write" {

+           and (.updated_at | test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:]{8}Z$"))' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE" >/dev/null
+    run --separate-stderr write_lines 3
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    jq -e '.lines == 7 and .over == true' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE" >/dev/null
+    # The stderr warning keeps its wording.
+    [[ "$stderr" == "[karpathy-surgical-warn] Session diff total 7 lines exceeds threshold 5. Karpathy principle 3 (Surgical Changes): verify every changed line traces to the stated task. State: $KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-sum.jsonl" ]]
+    ls "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE".tmp.* >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 1
+    true
+}

+    for i in $(seq -w 1 25); do
+        echo '{"lines_changed":1}' > "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-old-$i.jsonl"
+        touch -d "2026-01-01 00:00:$i" "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-old-$i.jsonl"
+    done
+    checkpoint sprint-256 bd-new
+    write_lines 1
+    [ "$(ls "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR"/*.jsonl | wc -l)" -eq 20 ]
+    [ -f "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-new.jsonl" ]
+    [ -f "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-old-25.jsonl" ]
+    [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-old-06.jsonl" ]
+    [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/bd-old-01.jsonl" ]
+}

+@test "KS-6 the legacy session-long state file is deleted on the first run" {
+    printf '{"lines_changed":900,"running_total":900}\n' > "$KARPATHY_LEGACY_STATE"
+    checkpoint sprint-256 bd-leg
+    write_lines 1
+    [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_LEGACY_STATE" ]
+    # The legacy total does not leak into the new layout.
+    [ "$(jq -r '.lines' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "1" ]
+}
+
+@test "KS-7 task names are sanitised to ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\$ and stay inside the state directory" {
+    checkpoint sprint-256 'bd-1'
+    jq '.checkpoint.task = "Task 2.3: ../../evil\nname"' "$T/run/sprint-plan-state.json" > "$T/s" && mv "$T/s" "$T/run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+    write_lines 1
+    run ls -A "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR"
+    [ "${#lines[@]}" -eq 1 ]
+    [[ "${lines[0]}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.jsonl$ ]]
+    [ "${lines[0]}" = "Task_2.3__.._.._evil_name.jsonl" ]
+    [ "$(find "$T" -name '*evil*' | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]
+    # A leading dot cannot make a hidden (unrotated) file.
+    jq '.checkpoint.task = ".hidden"' "$T/run/sprint-plan-state.json" > "$T/s" && mv "$T/s" "$T/run/sprint-plan-state.json"
+    write_lines 1
+    [ -f "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR/_hidden.jsonl" ]
+    [ "$(jq -r '.task' "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE")" = "_hidden" ]
+}
+
+@test "KS-8 knob off is silent: no state, no summary, no stderr" {
+    printf 'karpathy_principles:\n  surgical_diff_warning: false\n  diff_lines_per_task: 1\n' > "$LOA_CONFIG_OVERRIDE"
+    printf 'x\n' > "$KARPATHY_LEGACY_STATE"
+    run --separate-stderr write_lines 9
+    [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+    [ -z "$output" ] && [ -z "$stderr" ]
+    [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_STATE_DIR" ] && [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE" ]
+    # The `lean` profile turns it off without the key; an explicit true wins over lean.
+    printf 'loa:\n  profile: lean\nkarpathy_principles:\n  diff_lines_per_task: 1\n' > "$LOA_CONFIG_OVERRIDE"
+    run --separate-stderr write_lines 9
+    [ -z "$stderr" ] && [ ! -e "$KARPATHY_SUMMARY_FILE" ]
+    printf 'loa:\n  profile: lean\nkarpathy_principles:\n  surgical_diff_warning: true\n  diff_lines_per_task: 1\n' > "$LOA_CONFIG_OVERRIDE"
+    run --separate-stderr write_lines 9
+    [[ "$stderr" == *"[karpathy-surgical-warn]"* ]]
+}

+# (`run-checkpoint.sh read --json`), else the sprint, else the session id;
+# keeps one sanitised file per task under the state directory (at most 20);
+# deletes the legacy session-long file; writes the summary the review's

+setup() {

+    unset LOA_SESSION_ID LOA_PROFILE_CONFIG_FILE LOA_PROFILE_CACHE_FILE

+#
+# No profile can reach the floor. The floor source is .claude/data/floor.yaml
+# (read here, never duplicated); its sha256 pin is READ from
+# tests/unit/guard-origins.bats (FLOOR_SHA256) so the two suites cannot
+# disagree. Under `lean` every floor surface reads byte-identically to
+# `standard`: the floor config keys (the two gate skills' flatline_protocol.*
+# config, destructive_command_guard.*, implement_gate.*, hounfour.locality),
+# verdict-derive.sh on fixture feedback files, the adversarial gate's

+bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0

+setup() {

+    # (which carries the floor keys it really uses) with the profile set.

+@test "PF-1 floor.yaml matches the sha256 pin guard-origins.bats carries (one constant, two suites)" {

+    [ -n "$pin" ] || { echo "no FLOOR_SHA256 in guard-origins.bats"; return 1; }

+@test "PF-2 no profiles.yaml key matches a floor key or is an ancestor of one" {

+import re, subprocess, sys, json
+def load(p):

+import json, re, sys

+rxs = ["^" + ".+".join(re.escape(s) for s in p.split("*")) + "$" for p in pats]
+out = set(p for p in pats if "*" not in p)
+def walk(x, path):
+    if isinstance(x, dict):
+        for k, v in x.items():
+            walk(v, path + [str(k)])
+    if path:
+        key = ".".join(path)
+        if any(re.match(r, key) for r in rxs):

+for f in sys.argv[1:3]:
+    walk(json.load(open(f)), [])
